baseline_rules: fixed_best, fixed_v11 expert0/trunk.5, fixed_best_expert/trunk1; each arm progress and feedback as frozen Baseline implementation; no audit tuning.
scope_limits: B-to-C also changes correlated exploration support/magnitude, not pure action dimension.
